answer: At a small observatory on a river terrace, agents compete to detect changes in a nebula. Each report cites a signed telescope time slot and commits a hash of its raw frame before the reference image is released. Rewards track verified, non-overlapping observations, not the number of accounts: splitting one observation among ten identities cannot mint ten payouts. A Sybil operator must rent extra telescope time and risk a deposit for false claims. Stolen receipts or colluding staff could still fake provenance, so reviewers compare raw frames with an independent instrument.
